title: Nexus
summary: Full compromise of a small Linux target through a chain of four linked weaknesses. A public careers page leaked an account-naming convention and a database password was still recoverable from a Git repository's history, giving authenticated access to a Krayin CRM. A public CVE turned that access into web-tier code execution as www-data, a reused credential moved the foothold to the jones system account, and a root-run Gitea "template sync" service was abused with a hand-crafted Git tree to write a sudoers rule — ending in root without ever exploiting the kernel.
